title: Open a Web Terminal order page
description: Web Terminal block: load /order/<market> on the slot dev server (a full document load, which also re-reads persisted browser state) and wait until the header, the order form and the price chart are ready. No mutation.

navigate.intent: Open the market's order page as a trader typing its address

header.intent: Confirm the order header names the requested market

form.intent: Confirm the order form is on screen

chart.intent: Confirm the price chart loaded the market's data

capture.label: order-page-{{params.market}}
capture.intent: Keep a picture of the loaded order page

market.description: Testnet market reserved for this run.
